name: Liguria
summary: Vertical bands of green, red and sea blue with the regional arms: a stylised caravel beneath the Cross of Saint George of Genoa, with four stars for the provinces.
origin: The arms were adopted in 1985 and the flag by regional law on 7 July 1997.

symbols.name: Caravel
symbols.meaning: The maritime tradition and navigators such as Columbus.

symbols.name: Cross of Saint George
symbols.description: The red cross on white of the Republic of Genoa.

symbols.name: Four stars
symbols.meaning: The provinces of Genoa, Imperia, La Spezia and Savona.

facts: Christopher Columbus was born in Genoa.
Genoa's red cross on white is also the flag of England.
clues: Green, red and blue vertical bands with a caravel under a red cross.
Its ship honours a region of navigators.
Four stars stand for its provinces.
